facts.text: From West Stockholm, New York; a Graphic and Multimedia Design major at SUNY Canton who in February 2024 established the SUNY Canton chapter of the National Society of Leadership and Success and served as its president
Graduated from SUNY Canton in 2025 in Graphic and Multimedia Design
Received the Leaders of Tomorrow award at SUNY Canton's 2025 Student Excellence Awards Ceremony
Academic Intervention Service (AIS) teacher at St. James School in Gouverneur since 2020, providing math and ELA support for students from kindergarten through sixth grade

Holds permanent certification in Nursery, Kindergarten and Grades 1-6; her 0.30 FTE Title I teacher position assigned to St. James School was continued by the Gouverneur Central School District for the 2026-27 school year

Awarded the Expert Soldier Badge on October 1, 2021 at Fort Drum, one of the first four New York Army National Guard soldiers to earn it; at the time he was a sergeant first class serving full-time as a personnel specialist with the 427th Brigade Support Battalion
facts.source: New York Division of Military and Naval Affairs

facts.text: Author of 'Property Rights as a Cause of the Tragedy of the Commons: Institutional Change and the Pastoral Maasai of Kenya' (Eastern Economic Journal, Fall 1995), co-author of a 1995 New York Economic Review note on the aggregate demand and supply model, and co-author of a 1998 chapter on institutional constraints on entrepreneurship in Kenya's popular music industry
His St. Lawrence University research areas include economic development, minority middleman and supply chain networks, and the impact of foreign direct investment on economic development and growth
